title: Automatically open browser to log in to a network
line: A new "Open network login pages automatically" option opens the hotel or café Wi-Fi login page in the browser as soon as it is needed.
explanation: When NetworkManager reports a captive portal, plasma-nm's kded module only shows a persistent "You need to log into this network" notification; the login page opens only after clicking its Log in button. The change adds an OpenCaptivePortalAutomatically setting (off by default) with a checkbox in the Wi-Fi & Networking configuration dialog; when it is on, kded also opens the connectivity check page in the default browser the moment the portal is detected. The notification and its Log in button stay as before.

commits.message:
kded: optionally open the network login page automatically

When a captive portal was detected, a notification asked to log in and
the login page only opened after clicking its button. A new option in
the configuration dialog opens the page in the browser right away.

BUG: 470959

media.caption: Pure master: the network reports a captive portal and only the notification appears; nothing opens until you click Log in.
With the new option on, the login page opens in the browser by itself as soon as the portal is detected.
Wi-Fi & Networking configuration dialog on master.
The new "Open network login pages automatically" checkbox in the same dialog.
